text:
Carla (sales): Hey team — customer in APAC trying a POC, hitting a hard error when they try to pin a model in ap-southeast-1. Deadline in 48h, can we triage?
Sam (solutions): What error are they seeing?
Carla (sales): Copying log: 
```
{"error":"model_not_found","message":"Requested model 'redwood-llm-v1.3.0' isn't available in region ap-southeast-1"}
```
Sam (solutions): ok that looks like a region replication gap / deprecation. Which model variant did they request (full vs quant)?
Carla (sales): They asked to pin `redwood-llm-v1.3.0` (full), specifically for latency benchmarks. Customer insists on exact version.
Ryan (infra): @Maya can you check replication and deprecation flags for v1.3.0 in APAC? :eyes:
Maya (eng-oncall): Pulling it now. quick note — v1.3.0 had a security patch back in Nov and we deprecated the old binary in some regions while we rolled the patched build. Might explain missing index.
Alex (eng): If it's deprecation, the API returns model_not_found rather than a friendly deprecation notice. We should surface a better error but short-term: we can map pin -> nearest compatible variant.
Carla (sales): Customer won't accept an automatic mapping without approval. They need to know differences and cost impact.
Elaine (acct exec): Also we need to answer data residency and egress billing if we fallback to a global-hosted variant outside APAC.
Sam (solutions): Two immediate options: 1) replicate patched v1.3.0 binary to ap-southeast-1 (requires infra ops, ETA ~6-12 hrs) or 2) suggest pin to `redwood-llm-v1.3.1-patched` which is available everywhere but has slightly different tokenization behavior.
Maya (eng-oncall): Replication request submitted to infra — job id r-job-9921. I'll follow up when job completes.
Ryan (infra): FYI replication will use existing blobstore snapshot; cost is negligible but there's a small risk window. ETA estimate updated to ~8 hrs.
Alex (eng): On tokenization: v1.3.1 pads tokens differently in ~0.6% of cases (we measured on our eval set). We can produce a diff report for customer if they want.
Carla (sales): They asked about unit cost if we route to a region outside APAC for the trial — will they pay cross-region egress?
Elaine (acct exec): Pricing note: hosted API charges per-token at standard rate; cross-region egress is billed per our infra egress policy — for trials we can credit up to $200 of egress to keep POC moving. Need approval from finance.
Sam (solutions): For an immediate workaround, we can also provision a short-lived Dedicated instance in APAC with the patched model pre-loaded (if they want SLA-like performance). That's a heavier lift and needs sales purchasing signal.
Carla (sales): Customer prefers hosted but will consider dedicated if we prove latency. They asked for a timeline and a clear path to keep the pinned version or an exact diff so legal/devs can sign off.
Maya (eng-oncall): Replication job r-job-9921 started — I'll post updates. If replication fails, fallback plan is to allow pin -> alias mapping with explicit opt-in in the POC config so customer approves mapping.
Alex (eng): I'll generate a short compatibility report (tokenization diffs + edge-case examples) and a sample eval showing where outputs diverge. ETA 3 hrs.
Sam (solutions): I'll draft a suggested message for the customer: outline two options (replicate vs mapped variant), call out risk/behaviour differences, and include the credit offer for cross-region egress.
Carla (sales): Perfect — please keep it concise; customer legal wants the tokenization diff + any security notes about KMS/KPIs.
Ryan (infra): Quick security note — if we replicate binaries to APAC, KMS keys are region-specific; we'll need to ensure key access or rewrap. That might add ~1 hr.
Elaine (acct exec): I'll loop in finance for the egress credit approval and confirm whether we can fast-track a short Dedicated trial agreement.
Maya (eng-oncall): r-job-9921 update: snapshot copied to staging in ap-southeast-1, validation running. If validation passes we'll open the model for pinning. ETA 2.5 hrs.
Carla (sales): Thanks everyone — collecting: (1) compatibility report (Alex) 3h, (2) replication validation (Maya) ~2.5h, (3) customer message draft (Sam) ~1h, (4) finance check (Elaine) ongoing. Customer deadline in ~48h.
Sam (solutions): tagging checklist: @Alex please include a short CLI snippet customers can run to compare tokens locally. Example:
```
# compare tokenization
python -c "from redwood_tokenizer import tokenize;print(tokenize('Example text', model='v1.3.0'))"
```
Alex (eng): will do.
Maya (eng-oncall): validation passed on staging. I'll promote the replica to production for ap-southeast-1 and notify once pinning works.
deploy-bot: Deployment r-job-9921 completed ✅ promoted to ap-southeast-1
Carla (sales): Can someone confirm pin works now?
Maya (eng-oncall): Confirmed: pin to `redwood-llm-v1.3.0` in ap-southeast-1 succeeds for me.
Carla (sales): Sending to customer now with the compatibility report + optional dedicated info. Thanks all :hugging_face:
